model.name: RbSnapNav
model.note: Custom element <rb-snap-nav> — R31.5.3, the data-driven bottom scroll-snap nav bar. FRESH component (unlike 5.4 which reused RbStrip). Reads the rb-strip (5.2) COMPARTMENT segments and emits one button per compartment; button click -> native scrollIntoView(compartment snap point), no JS scroll math. Bars are NOT nav buttons (compartments-only snap targets, consistent w/ 5.4). Fresh uuid per architect. Expert builds rb-snap-nav.ts.
